1 to several days (each boss only once per 20 h; the final fight can last up to 30 min)

The {npc:Messenger of Heaven} warns that the deeds of Ferumbras and the servants of the *thing from beyond* have shattered the world and that forces of destruction are devouring reality. You earn the achievement **Ender of the End**, a chest with rewards (including the {item:Vibrant Egg} for the Sparkion mount) and, through {npc:Yana}, access to Powerful imbuements.

Otherworld (through the Glowing Vortexes of Ankrahmun, Svargrond and Zao)

Once every 14 days (13 days and 20 hours since the Winter Update 2022); to repeat it you need another 5 charges.

After killing the World Devourer: say {key:worth} to {npc:Yana}, in the Adventurers' Guild.

Only one of the three {wiki:Glowing Vortex|Glowing Vortexes} (Ankrahmun, Svargrond or Zao) is open at a time. The location is drawn at random every **2 hours**, counting from server save (the same one can come up again). A {item:Spying Eye} tells you where it is.
Each initial boss is tied to an entrance: **Anomaly** to Ankrahmun, **Rupture** to Zao and **Realityquake** to Svargrond. You can kill them in any order, as long as the matching entrance is open.
All bosses except the World Devourer can be killed **once every 20 hours**. Each boss room takes up to 5 players for **15 minutes**; when time runs out you are teleported out.
You can see your charges in the {wiki:Quest Log}.
Bring protection against **energy** and weapons with **earth** damage: that is what helps most against the Otherworld creatures.
If you get lost, go to the teleport room (hub), which is a safe zone: from there you can use a {wiki:Temple Teleport} or follow the exit path to the Darama entrance (Ankrahmun).

The {wiki:Otherworld} has three entrances, each with a {npc:Messenger of Heaven} and a {wiki:Glowing Vortex}. They all lead to the same dungeon; only the spot where you arrive changes. Only one is open at a time and the location changes randomly every 2 hours (counting from server save).
Find out which entrance is open

If you have a {item:Spying Eye}, use it: it tells you where the vortex is open. Without one, go to the nearest entrance and check whether the vortex is there. The Spying Eye messages that matter for this quest are the ones in the table; the Kazordoon and Edron ones refer to two weaker Otherworlds (near the Dwarf Bridge and north of Edron) that are not part of this quest.
Glowing Vortex, the entrance to the Otherworld

Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat (for example from Venore, with {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the harbour next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}. Leave the city to the **north** and cross the {wiki:Kha'labal} desert to the {npc:Messenger of Heaven}. This entrance's vortex leads to the **Anomaly** route.
Messenger of Heaven and Glowing Vortex, north of Ankrahmun
To return, walk **south** through the desert to Ankrahmun and take {npc:Captain Sinbeard}'s boat at the harbour (for example {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}).

Go to **Svargrond** by boat from **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the eastern part of the city. Leave the city to the **south-west**, on foot across the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}, towards {wiki:Ragnir}. The Messenger and the vortex are **1 floor above** ground level. This vortex leads to the **Realityquake** route.
Messenger of Heaven and Glowing Vortex, south-west of Svargrond
To return, retrace your steps **north-east** to Svargrond and take {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat: {key:hi}, the name of the city ({key:carlin}, {key:thais} or {key:venore}) and {key:yes}.

Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine** with {npc:Brodrosch} (far below Kazordoon) or {npc:Gurbasch} (8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya}; {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya with {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}): {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}. You arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}. In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the lift takes you up to the surface of the mountain. Follow the passage **east**, going down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out on the {wiki:Zao Steppe}. Then head **north**, along the **west** side of the steppe, to the Messenger. This vortex leads to the **Rupture** route.
Exit of the mountain passage onto the Zao Steppe
Messenger of Heaven and Glowing Vortex, west of the Zao Steppe

To return: go back to the passage ({coord:33085,31532,7}), climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} and head **west** to the lift. On the steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Kazordoon ({key:kazordoon}) or Cormaya ({key:cormaya}).
2. Accept the quest and enter the Otherworld
Talk to the Messenger of Heaven

At whichever entrance is open, talk to the {npc:Messenger of Heaven}: say {key:hi}, {key:strong} and {key:yes}. If you want to hear the whole story, before {key:strong} you can ask about {key:alive}, {key:peril}, {key:damage}, {key:stopped}, {key:destroying} and {key:Heart of Destruction}.
If you already have the quest, {key:strong} only gets the reply *Your future is still not written because the forces of uncreation are still tearing on reality.*

In the room below the NPC is the {wiki:Glowing Vortex}. **Before** you go in, kill **10 creatures** that roam around the vortex: {creature:Sparkion|Sparkions}, {creature:Reality Reaver|Reality Reavers}, {creature:Dread Intruder|Dread Intruders} and {creature:Breach Brood|Breach Broods}. You only need to do it **once**: from then on you have permanent access to the vortex.

Step into the {wiki:Glowing Vortex}. You appear in the {wiki:Otherworld}, at a spot that depends on the entrance you used. From here follow the boss section for that entrance: Ankrahmun → section 4 (Anomaly), Zao → section 5 (Rupture), Svargrond → section 6 (Realityquake).
The Otherworld is full of strong creatures and it is easy to get lost. Some passages change when the open entrance changes and can stop you from leaving the way you came in (see the next step).
How to leave the Otherworld (applies to the whole quest)

The safest way is to go to the Otherworld's **teleport room (hub)** (section 7), which is a safe zone: from there you can use a {wiki:Temple Teleport} (bought in the Store) to return to your city's temple. If you do not have one, step into the red vortex to the **north** of the hub (the exit): you appear at the hub's entrance vortex ({coord:32162,31327,11}). From there follow the path in the image: fight your way **south** and **go down 2 floors**, towards the **Darama** entrance (the vortex north of Ankrahmun, {coord:33171,32633,7}). It is the same path you use when you start in Ankrahmun. This path **always** works as a way out, whichever entrance is open at the time. Once in the desert, walk **south** to Ankrahmun and take {npc:Captain Sinbeard}'s boat.
Area that can be blocked: Darama / Anomaly
Area that can be blocked: Zao / Rupture
Area that can be blocked: Svargrond / Realityquake
Path out of the hub towards the Darama entrance (Ankrahmun)

There are three places (one per entrance) where a wall appears when the entrance changes: only one of them is open at a time, and that is why each initial boss is tied to a city (see the coordinates). If you get stuck in one of those areas, look for the **emergency exit** right next to the wall. There are also other vortexes scattered around (for example at {coord:32103,31402,13}) that can get you out of a room where you are stuck; check carefully where they lead before relying on them.
The {wiki:Temple Teleport} does not work with a battle sign, with a PZ lock or in areas where you cannot log out.

Your first mission is to gather **5 charges**, one from each of 5 different servants of the World Devourer. First you kill Anomaly, Rupture and Realityquake (in any order). With those three dead, you gain access to Outburst and Eradicator through the teleport room (hub). With the 5 charges, you can enter the heart of destruction.
Each charge boss takes a team of **up to 5 players** for at most **15 minutes**; when time runs out, you are teleported out. You can repeat each one **once every 20 hours**.
Chargers and 6 Overcharges (team split into 2 groups)
The Hunger, The Destruction and The Rage
Recommended protection: **death** and **energy**. On the following maps you start at the first marked point, change floor at the second (stairs/holes) and finish at the destination.
Step into the Ankrahmun Glowing Vortex ({coord:33171,32633,7}). In the Otherworld, head **west** from the arrival point to the marked point and **go up 1 floor**.
On the floor above, head **south** to the marked point and **go down 1 floor**.
Head **north-west** to the cross: there you will find a set of tiles next to a lever.
Tiles and lever of the Anomaly puzzle
Pull the lever and enter the Vortex (Purple)

Put the team on the tiles and pull the lever. You appear on a small island with a {wiki:Vortex (Purple)}. When you step into it, each player ends up in one of **2 groups**: 1st, 3rd and 5th on one side; 2nd and 4th on the other. During the puzzle the two groups take turns being teleported to another room full of strong creatures.

After the vortex, {creature:Charger|Chargers} keep appearing non-stop: kill them. After about a dozen, **one of the groups** is sent to a room with {creature:Overcharge|Overcharges}, where it can only stay for **10 seconds**: in that time deal as much damage as possible to the Overcharges. When one dies you see *A shift in polarity switches creatures with corresponding polarity into another phase of existence.* When the team is back together, kill more Chargers and the **other group** goes to the Overcharges room. Repeat until you have killed **6 Overcharges**: you then see *You have reached a charge potential to proceed to challenge the minion of destruction.*
Whoever stays in the starting room while the other group is with the Overcharges can stand on {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bombs}: at that point there is no need to kill Chargers.
Once you get the charge message, leave through the **same vortex** you came in by and return to the lever area.
Step into the {wiki:Vortex (Red)|red vortex} **east** of the lever you already used. You appear on another island with **5 tiles** and a lever: put the team on the tiles and pull the lever.
Red vortex east of the lever
Island with the 5 tiles and the lever

You appear on an island with {creature:Anomaly} and 4 {creature:Spark of Destruction|Sparks of Destruction}. Every now and then Anomaly turns into {creature:Charged Anomaly}, which is **immune to all attacks**. When that happens, lure it onto a {wiki:Vortex (Red)|red vortex}: each pass takes **6000 HP** off it. These vortexes appear at random spots in the room and anyone who steps on one takes **100 energy damage**.
The Charged Anomaly hits much harder than the normal Anomaly, but it is much slower.
Since it changes target often, it is best for the team to stand still while the blocker leads it to the red vortex; only the druid moves to stay within range of {spell:Heal Friend}.
After you kill it, leave through the room's vortex: as with the other charge bosses, you end up in the Otherworld's **teleport room (hub)** (section 7).
Recommended protection: **energy** and **death**. This puzzle needs at least **4 players**.
Step into the Zao Steppe Glowing Vortex ({coord:33036,31374,7}). In the Otherworld, head **north** to the marked point and **go down 1 floor**.
On the floor below, head **north** to the marked point and **go up 1 floor**.
Head **west** to the cross: there you will find the tiles next to the lever.
Tiles and lever of the Rupture puzzle
Put the team on the tiles and pull the lever. You enter the puzzle room from the **east** side, where there is a permanent vortex.

**Do not step on** the permanent vortex to the east, where you came in: it is the exit and, if you leave before finishing the puzzle, you have to start all over again. Throw a {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bomb} on it to act as a marker.

{creature:Crackler|Cracklers} are invincible, but they can be turned into {creature:Depolarized Crackler|Depolarized Cracklers}, which can be killed. To do that, **4 players** have to stand on vortexes that appear at random spots in the room. While they are there, the Cracklers transform and the team has to attack them as fast as possible, **without moving**. If someone leaves a vortex or the vortexes change place, look for the new positions to weaken them again. When you kill them you see *You have reached enough charges to pass further into the destruction*: you can leave through the vortex to the **east**.

Cracklers attack from a distance, but Depolarized Cracklers fight in melee and hit harder. Be careful not to get surrounded when they transform; if it gets too dangerous, step off the vortex and they transform back and move away.

Step into the red vortex at {coord:32090,31319,13}. You appear on an island: get the team into position and pull the levers to enter {creature:Rupture}'s room, where there are also 4 {creature:Spark of Destruction|Sparks of Destruction}.

A few times during the fight a {creature:Damage Resonance} appears with another 4 Sparks of Destruction. When that happens, **everyone stops attacking Rupture immediately**: every attack it takes at that point heals it for **4000 HP**. Kill the Damage Resonance and only then go back to attacking Rupture.
Do not use damage-over-time (DoT) attacks: they keep hitting Rupture and heal it while the Damage Resonance is alive.
After you kill Rupture, leave through the {wiki:Vortex (Green)|green vortex} on the **west** side of the room: you appear in the teleport room (hub).
Recommended protection: **energy**, **death** and **holy**. The boss has two forms before Realityquake appears, each with different weaknesses.
Step into the Svargrond Glowing Vortex ({coord:32166,31294,6}). In the Otherworld, head **north-east** to the marked point and **go down 1 floor**.
On the floor below, head **east** to the marked point and **go up 1 floor**.
Head **east/north-east** to the cross, next to the puzzle lever and the boss's red vortex.
Put the team next to the lever and pull it to enter the puzzle area.

In the room, {creature:Unstable Spark|Unstable Sparks} appear in waves that vanish after only **8 seconds**, followed by another wave, and so on. The team has to kill **10**: be quick and always attack **the same creature**. Each time one dies you see, coming from the middle of the room, *The death of the spark charges the room*. When you kill the last one you see *The room is fully charged up! You are permeated with its power and can venture deeper into the heart of destruction now!*
The usual strategy is to put the team on the **west** side of the room, with the blocker a few squares further **east**, while the shooters attack quickly.
With the room charged, leave through the vortex on the **north** side of the room.
Step into the red vortex to the **south**. You reach a small room where the team gets back into position: pull the lever to go to the boss room.

First {creature:Foreshock} appears with some {creature:Spark of Destruction|Sparks of Destruction}. During the fight it can turn into {creature:Aftershock}, teleporting to the centre of the room and summoning 4 Sparks of Destruction. The two forms swap every now and then, so change weapon/spell according to the form.

Knights: ice/energy weapons on Foreshock and death/earth/fire on Aftershock. Monks: energy/physical on Foreshock and earth on Aftershock. Mages: the right runes and spells for each form. Paladins: physical spells on Foreshock and {spell:Divine Caldera}, {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes} and, if you like, {wiki:Powerful Reap} on the crossbow against Aftershock.
After you kill Foreshock and Aftershock, {creature:Realityquake} appears with more Sparks of Destruction. Kill it.
After you kill it, leave through the room's vortex: as with the other charge bosses, you end up in the **teleport room (hub)** (section 7).
This is where you appear after killing a charge boss. It is a safe zone, with a {npc:Messenger of Heaven}, and from here the teleports to Outburst, Eradicator and World Devourer depart.
Go to the hub without killing a boss
If you are not in the hub yet, you can get there on foot from any entrance, following the paths in the images. The hub entrance is a vortex at {coord:32162,31327,11}.
Path from the Ankrahmun entrance to the hub
Path from the Zao entrance to the hub
Path from the Svargrond entrance to the hub
The teleports to Outburst and Eradicator only work after you kill Anomaly, Rupture and Realityquake; the central vortex only with the 5 charges.
Outburst lever room; leaving again to the west, you reach the Anomaly area
Hub entrance vortex ({coord:32162,31327,11}); from there you go out to the Darama entrance

Only after Anomaly, Rupture and Realityquake. Against Outburst use **fire** and **energy** (avoid death) and wear protection against **death** and **energy**. Against Charging Outburst use **physical** damage and wear protection against **energy**.

In the hub, step into the **north-west** teleport. You appear in a small room with **5 tiles** and a lever: put the team on the tiles and pull the lever to be taken to the boss room, a little to the east.

{creature:Outburst} appears with 4 {creature:Spark of Destruction|Sparks of Destruction}. During the fight it turns into {creature:Charging Outburst}, which is vulnerable to **physical damage**: knights and monks use physical damage weapons, paladins {item:Strong Ethereal Spear|Strong Ethereal Spears}/{item:Ethereal Spear|Ethereal Spears} and mages {item:Explosion Rune|Explosion Runes}.

If Charging Outburst does not die within **12 seconds**, it explodes and deals a lot of energy damage. Lower-level teams should wear {item:Shockwave Amulet|Shockwave Amulets} and {item:Might Ring|Might Rings} in case they cannot kill it in time.
After you kill it, leave through the {wiki:Vortex (Green)|green vortex}: you return to the teleport room (hub).
Only after Anomaly, Rupture and Realityquake. Use **death** damage and wear protection against **death** and **energy**.

In the hub, step into the **north-east** teleport. You appear in a small room with **5 tiles** and a lever: put the team on the tiles and pull the lever to be taken to the boss room, a little to the west.

{creature:Eradicator} appears with 4 {creature:Spark of Destruction|Sparks of Destruction}. Every now and then it switches, for a few seconds, to a more vulnerable form; each time another 4 Sparks of Destruction appear (2 to the north, 2 to the south). Keep clearing the Sparks as they appear so you do not get surrounded. The boss has high resistances to every element **except death**: everyone uses death weapons and spells and {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes}, and paladins should put {wiki:Powerful Reap} on the crossbow.
After you kill it, leave through the {wiki:Vortex (Green)|green vortex} on the **east** side of the room: you return to the teleport room (hub).
Eradicator charge (5th charge, if you already have the others)
10. Into the Heart of Destruction: The Hunger, The Destruction and The Rage

With the 5 charges you can face the heart of destruction. This fight takes **up to 15 players** and can last **up to 30 minutes**. Coordination is essential: before going in, everyone must know exactly what their job is and where to stand.
Prepare the team and the supplies
Make sure the team is well stocked: some area runes (about **300**), {item:Sudden Death Rune|SDs} (**300 to 400**) and as many health or mana potions as you can carry.
Mages below level 400 may struggle to carry enough {item:Ultimate Mana Potion|Ultimate Mana Potions}: ask one of the knights to carry some for you.

In the hub, step into the vortex in the **centre of the room**. You appear in a small room with **15 tiles** and a lever. The team splits into 3 groups of 5 according to the column of tiles: **west** (left) faces {creature:The Hunger} first, **middle** faces {creature:The Destruction} first and **east** (right) faces {creature:The Rage} first. Balance the 3 groups well before pulling the lever.

During this phase you are teleported between the three rooms every **30 seconds**, with the message *A polarity shift moves you into another part of the heart of destruction*. The three bosses have to die **at the same time**: get them all well into the red and stop attacking until the others are at a similar level. When the team confirms that all three are almost dead, kill them in the next round.

{creature:The Hunger} appears in this room with constant Sparks of Destruction and, every now and then, {creature:Greed|Greeds}. Greeds are **immune to all damage** but hit hard, so they have to be removed: the blocker makes The Hunger walk over the vortex in the centre of the room, which **changes colour**; then they lure the Greed onto the vortex and it disappears.

{creature:The Destruction} appears with constant Sparks of Destruction and, every now and then, {creature:Disruption|Disruptions}. When a Disruption appears, kill it **right away, as fast as possible**: otherwise it turns into the much stronger {creature:Charged Disruption} and {creature:Overcharged Disruption}, which makes the fight much harder.
{creature:The Rage} appears with constant Sparks of Destruction and, every now and then, {creature:Frenzy|Frenzies}. When a Frenzy appears, kill it **right away, as fast as possible**.

When the three aspects die, you are pulled into the {creature:World Devourer}'s room, full of Sparks of Destruction, with the message *With the Rage, Hunger and Destruction gone, you're sucked into the heart of destruction!! THE WORLD DEVOURER AWAITS YOU!* Everyone goes **quickly** to their positions. It is recommended to stay in the marked area: the mages protected to the **west** and the blockers with the creatures and the boss to the **east**.
Deal with Greeds, Frenzies and Disruptions

During the fight Greeds, Frenzies and Disruptions also appear: handle them **exactly as in the first phase** (Greed onto the vortex after the boss has passed over it; Disruptions and Frenzies killed immediately, with priority on the **Disruptions**, so they do not reach the overcharged form). Since there are many Sparks of Destruction, use area attacks almost all the time and save single-target attacks for the creatures that have to die quickly.

Sparks only appear when the World Devourer is attacked. To remove the Greeds easily, the team can stop area attacks and kill the remaining Sparks with single-target attacks only: the room gets cleared and it is faster to bring the boss and the Greed to the vortex. The longer the Greed stays alive, the more Greeds appear.

You will always have lots of creatures on screen. Open the {wiki:Battle Window} showing only creatures and sort it **by name, ascending**: that way Frenzies and Disruptions always stay at the top of the list and the shooters find them quickly.
When the World Devourer dies you receive the achievement **Ender of the End** and you see *VICTORY! THE WORLD DEVOURER HAS FALLEN!* Leave through the vortex on the **east** side of the room.
Once the fight is over, the reward is in a room with a {item:Treasure Chest (Ornamented)|chest}. Open it to receive the quest reward.
{item:Vibrant Egg}: use it to receive the {wiki:Sparkion (Mount)|Sparkion} mount

When you leave the reward room you are sent to the area next to the hub vortex. From there, step into the vortex to go to the hub and use a {wiki:Temple Teleport}, or follow the exit path to the **Darama** entrance (Ankrahmun), as in the step *How to leave the Otherworld* in section 2.
Where you appear when leaving the reward room
Be careful on the way out: lots of Otherworld creatures will be waiting for you. Leave with the team together and with full health and mana.
If you do not have the Powerful Strike, Void and Vampirism imbuements yet, you have to talk to Yana after killing the World Devourer.

Go to the temple of any city and use an {item:Adventurer's Stone}: you are teleported to the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild}. If you do not have one, ask a temple NPC for another ({key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}). {npc:Yana} is on the **upper floor** of the guild.
To leave, use the guild's exit portal, which returns you to the temple you came from.
Say {key:hi} and {key:worth} to {npc:Yana}. She confirms that you defeated the World Devourer and grants you the {wiki:Powerful Strike}, {wiki:Powerful Void} and {wiki:Powerful Vampirism} imbuements.
Powerful Strike, Powerful Void and Powerful Vampirism imbuements

Yana also trades {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens} ({key:trade} or {key:tokens}) for the creature products of the Strike, Vampirism and Void imbuements (2, 4 and 6 tokens for Basic, Intricate and Powerful) and for the *of Destruction* weapons (50 tokens). Buying the products does not exempt you from earning the right to make the Powerful imbuements.
14. Repeat: Gold Tokens and World Devourer
After killing Anomaly, Rupture and Realityquake once, you can farm {item:Gold Token|Gold Tokens} every day by killing the bosses. The route depends on which entrance is open.

Each charge boss can be killed **once every 20 hours**. The {creature:World Devourer} can be killed **once every 14 days** (since the Winter Update 2022, 13 days and 20 hours), but for that you need **5 charges** again, which means killing at least 5 of the other bosses again. You can see the charges you have in the {wiki:Quest Log}.

Step into the vortex and continue to {creature:Rupture} (section 5). After you kill it and reach the hub, step into the **north-west** teleport and leave again to the **west**: you end up in the {creature:Anomaly} boss area; kill it. When you leave you return to the hub. Go to the **north-west** teleport again and pull the room's lever to face {creature:Outburst}. Back in the hub, step into the **north-east** teleport to face {creature:Eradicator}.
Path from the Zao entrance to the hub

Step into the vortex and continue to {creature:Realityquake} (section 6). After you kill it and reach the hub, do the same as on the Zao route: **north-west** teleport and exit to the **west** for Anomaly, then **north-west** teleport and lever for Outburst and, finally, **north-east** teleport for Eradicator.
Path from the Svargrond entrance to the hub

Step into the vortex and follow the short path in the image to the hub. Step into the **north-west** teleport and leave again to the **west**: you end up in the Anomaly area; kill it. When you leave you return to the hub. Then **north-west** teleport and lever for Outburst and, finally, **north-east** teleport for Eradicator.
Path from the Ankrahmun entrance to the hub

With this route you kill 3 bosses when you start in Ankrahmun or 4 when you start in Zao or Svargrond, which gives on average **12 to 16 Gold Tokens**. You can use them for {wiki:Imbuing} or sell them for a good price. All the bosses always drop Gold Tokens; Anomaly, Rupture and World Devourer also always drop {item:Mysterious Remains} (the others can drop them). They can also drop items such as {item:Void Boots}, {item:Tiara of Power} and plasma rings and necklaces.
Leave at the end of the route

To leave, step into the hub's **north** teleport and fight your way **south**, **going down 2 floors**, to the Darama entrance, north of Ankrahmun: it is the same path you use when you start in Ankrahmun. Alternatively, use a {wiki:Temple Teleport} in the hub (safe zone). See also the step *How to leave the Otherworld* in section 2.
The Powerful imbuements were added as a reward of this quest in the Summer Update 2017, when chargeable weapons ({wiki:Charging}) were removed.
The {item:Vibrant Egg} is tradeable: you do not need to do the quest to use an egg and receive the Sparkion mount.
When you use {item:Mysterious Remains} you receive a random item, among them {item:Folded Void Carpet}, {item:Folded Rift Carpet}, {item:Gold Ingot}, {item:Stealth Ring} or {item:Red Dragon Scale}.
The {npc:Messenger of Heaven} also appears inside the Otherworld, in the teleport room (hub).
There are two weaker Otherworlds, with entrances near the Dwarf Bridge and north of Edron, that are not part of this quest.
